name: Seiyaku no Shinobi
source:
"Be a servant of the warlord to gather information--"
Part of a group of skillful ninjas, loyal only to carrying out their missions.
"Devoted Ninja"'s next target is the well-known warlord!
Warlord & Ninja.
Set in the age of civil wars, a forbidden love story begins…!

[from [url=https://aminoapps.com/c/yaoi-anime-and-manga/page/blog/devoted-ninja-yaoi-gamers-game-of-the-week/PE5b_BZtmuNrPgxR4NXzBoxWo5VbP23x32]Amino[/url]]
translation:
“成为军阀的仆人，收集情报——”

他们是一群技艺高超的忍者，只忠于执行任务。
“忠义忍者”的下一个目标，是那位声名显赫的军阀！

军阀与忍者。
在战国时代，禁忌之恋就此开始……！
